title: Kambing Rembau
genre: Malay cumbia (Colombian cumbia rhythm with Malay folk spirit)
subject: Abang Usop, a mason who usually builds drains and bus stops in Rembau, gets three weeks to make the town's cement buffalo monument; at the unveiling a child shouts 'kambing!', the name sticks, and the lopsided 'goat' becomes the town's proudest landmark.
caption: Malay cumbia with a village-band feel. A scraped guiro keeping the steady cumbia shuffle, congas and an alegre drum playing the lilting pattern, a singing accordion carrying the melody, a nylon-string guitar strumming the off-beats, and a rolling tumbao electric bass. Warm open-air live-band sound, congas and accordion forward, dry voices. Male mid baritone with a storyteller's grin singing short lines, a mixed village chorus answering the hook. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 100 BPM, G major. Cheeky, communal and proud. No dembow, no reggaeton beat, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no dangdut kendang, no EDM drop.
lyrics:
[Intro - guiro and congas, accordion enters]
[Verse 1]
Abang Usop tukang simen
Biasa buat longkang, perhentian bas
Majlis daerah bagi tiga minggu
Buat tugu kerbau Rembau
[Pre-Chorus]
Tanduk dia senget, kaki dia pendek
Usop gosok simen siang malam
[Chorus]
Kambing, kambing Rembau
Kambing simen kita semua
Tanduk senget, kita bangga
Kambing, kambing Rembau
[Verse 2]
Hari rasmi, kain dibuka
Seorang budak menjerit kuat
Mak, tengok! Kambing besar!
Semua orang ketawa terbahak-bahak
[Pre-Chorus]
Usop garu kepala, Pak Imam senyum
Nama itu dah melekat
[Chorus]
Kambing, kambing Rembau
Kambing simen kita sayang
Tanduk senget, kita bangga
Kambing, kambing Rembau
[Bridge - accordion solo, chorus clapping]
Orang luar tanya, mana kerbau?
[Chorus]
Kambing, kambing Rembau
Kambing Usop kita semua
Tanduk senget, kita bangga
Kambing, kambing Rembau
[Outro - guiro, congas, full chorus]
Kerbau pun malu, kambing pun senyum
